description: Main script for the Deep Research Agent utilizing recursive planning, research execution, and web search integration. Sets up an agent with configuration, routing, and startup display, defining the core entry point for the agent's operation.

classes.name: Agent
classes.description: An object representing the agent initialized with specific configurations, capable of including routers and running the agent server.

classes.name: AIConfig
classes.description: Configuration object for AI model parameters used by the agent.

methods.name: include_router
methods.description: Method of the Agent class to include routing endpoints for planning and research.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Method of the Agent class to start the agent server, either with an automatic port or specified port.
